newsitem.title: CANADA: Unions reach agreement with CP Rail.
newsitem.headline: Unions reach agreement with CP Rail.

text.p: A union representing 1,800 employees of Canadian Pacific Ltd unit CP Rail reached a new collective agreement, a union said on Monday.
The Transportation-Communications Union said the agreement preserved the worker's seniority rights across Canada as the Calgary-based railway splits its operations along east-west lines.
The agreement kept intact the benefits to which members ware entitled under the Employment Security package and extended the benefits to new areas, the union said.
The agreement also contained wage increases and benefit improvements.

Local union representatives met in Montreal over the weekend and endorsed the contract, which was subject to ratification by its members, representing operations support staff and the Communications Council of the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, representing signal maintenance staff at the railway.
